description: Step 3 of the fz-sc8.197 page. A table in the extern lowering (native_codegen/prim.rs): fz_op_{add,sub,mul}_ii as overflow-checked add/sub/mul, fz_op_{lt,lte,gt,gte,eq,neq}_ii as compares. Measured in a spike on #592: distiller no measurable change, byte walk -1.2%, index walk -3.0%; overflow output identical. The interpreter and the JIT must agree (three-path parity).

comments.text: No longer blocked by fz-sc8.212 (parked). The splice (emit_extern_call) knows which extern it emits; the instruction table keys on that. Measured on top of the splice: distiller no change, p1b -1.2%, p2b -3.0%.

Fresh evidence (Optimize, release AOT disassembly of spin/2 on b237ec0a0 + #674): `def spin(0, acc), do: acc; def spin(n, acc), do: spin(n - 1, acc + n)` runs ~93 instructions per iteration. The clause body (~77) calls _fz_op_sub_ii and _fz_op_add_ii (each `adds/subs; cset w1,vs; ret`, runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:949 integer_arithmetic_export!), each followed by 11 instructions decoding the overflow flag into a branch; the two calls are why the clause saves/restores 9 callee-saved registers. Binary: GC scratch 9x7-14/b-V0/spin.bin.

Coordination note: fz-nml.8 (JSON session, building) renames runtime fz_bs_write_int (runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs) into a scalar-word writer that also takes floats, and edits native_codegen/prim.rs bitstring construction. Whoever builds this ticket rebases on it.

Fresh evidence (MDF runtime hunt, develop 1438c8bfa, bench): integer +, -, * compile to an out-of-line call per operation (lib/kernel.fz:969 -> extern fz_op_add_ii, runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:956) plus 13 instructions testing the failure flag: 38 instructions per byte on the byte-walk probe, no cycles today (the 20.3 cycles/byte are serial register-pair pushes/pops across dispatch and __clause_0; see ../fz-sc8.byte-walk-loop.html). MDF proposed this as "Integer add, subtract and multiply are emitted inline": it is this ticket.

title: Integer arithmetic and comparison externs are emitted as instructions
